<cite ref="Yoma 53b:1">Yoma 53ᵇ</cite> <he>דתרום רישך אכולה כ׳</he> that thy head be raised over the whole city (that thou become the leader of the Jewish community).
<cite ref="Taanit 22a:3">Taan. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מגנית אכולה כ׳</he> thou art the protector of the whole community.

<cite ref="Chullin 56b:14">Ḥull. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דכולה ביה</he> a community in which everything (all classes) can be found; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="K01205"><he>כְּרַכִּין</he></cite>, <he>כְּרַכַּיָּא</he>, <he>כַּרְכּ׳</he>.
